ab_navigation_customization.reason: Tenant/menu composite-key configuration; the public identity is the existing menu PID, while the separate immutable audit records the authenticated actor.

ab_navigation_audit.reason: Append-only navigation audit uses its own public PID and explicit actor_id; it has no generic creator/updater lifecycle.

ab_role_navigation_state.reason: Tenant/role composite-key navigation selection stores its last actor in updated_by; role PID remains the public resource identity.

ab_role_navigation_menu.reason: Internal tenant/role/menu relationship is identified by its composite primary key and belongs to the role selection foreign key; it is not an independently editable business record.

ab_role_navigation_audit.reason: Append-only role navigation history retains its own PID and authenticated actor_id; generic update audit columns would misdescribe an immutable event.

ab_external_ingress_defaults.reason: Installation-scoped idempotency defaults use a composite natural key and tenant/installation foreign key; machine-owned request receipts are not generic user-editable records.

ab_wechat_subscription_event.reason: Authenticated provider events are global to app/openid/template; a per-tenant copy would duplicate one-time consent. Immutable facts use event_key and provider occurrence identity.

ab_wechat_subscription_state.reason: Global provider revocation watermark is keyed by app/openid/template so another tenant cannot replenish revoked consent; it has no tenant-local business-record identity.

ab_wechat_subscription_grant.reason: One immutable provider-confirmed grant has a global natural grant_reference and event foreign key, preventing duplicate consent capacity across tenants.

ab_wechat_subscription_observation.reason: Immutable authenticated client observation keeps tenant_id, user_id, identity_pid and an idempotency composite key; it cannot become provider consent or a mutable business record.

ab_wechat_subscription_reservation.reason: Append-only tenant-bound ownership of a global one-time provider grant uses resolution/reservation references; unknown and failed deliveries never recycle this ownership.

ab_installed_integration_recovery.reason: Append-only recovery authorization retains public PID, tenant, requested_by_pid, reason, version and before/after fingerprints; it is not a generic mutable audit entity.

ab_plugin_handover_batch.reason: Immutable PREVIEWED batch already retains public PID, tenant and created_by; it grants no mutation authority and has no updater lifecycle.

ab_plugin_handover_item.reason: Immutable preview item belongs to the tenant/batch foreign key and resource/ordinal unique keys. Resource PID is the original target identity, not a separately editable item record.
